wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: DELTA of $0.29, and it is the FILER's arithmetic, not a read. The four Form A rows are 40.00 + 417.00 + 119.00 + 346.29 = 922.29; cover line 1 prints 922 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST blank, so the scopes coincide). Every amount was re-read in a 1000 dpi cell crop: the first three carry a superscript '00' cents group over a rule, and the fourth unambiguously carries '29'. The same four transactions are re-listed on Form B, where the fourth is written '346' with NO cents, and Form B therefore sums to exactly 922. The filer rounded the 29 cents away when he carried the figure to the cover and to Form B; both figures are retained verbatim and nothing was adjusted to close. Cover line 2 (<=$50 aggregate) is blank in all three columns, so no small-donor money is hidden outside the itemisation.

expenditures.detail: Four Form B rows sum 40.00+417.00+119.00+346.00 = 922.00, equal to cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST blank), so the scopes coincide on this single report. All four Form B amounts are written as whole dollars with no cents group at all.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr form prints no schedule total or page subtotal, and this filer wrote none. Cover lines are the only anchors. Form B: rows 922.00 = cover line 3 (922), gates. Form A: rows 922.29 vs cover line 1 (922) - does NOT gate, reported as a delta above with both figures named.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 returns geometry_status 'gaps' - one interior rule at 14.26% is INTERPOLATED, not measured (the known tool DEBT), so the band map was crop-proved rather than trusted: measured rules 7.63 / 10.02 / 12.21 / [14.26] / 16.31 / 18.31 give writing lines 1-5, and ink sits on lines 1, 2, 3 and 5 with line 4 GENUINELY BLANK (the filer skipped a line before the Sept 22 entry). 4 rows emitted, line_no 1-4 in printed order, geometry pointing at bands 1, 2, 3 and 5. rowbands.py p3: geometry ok, 39 bands, ink on bands 1-4 consecutively = 4 rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: 1000 dpi crop spanning bands 1-3 of the amount column renders '40 00', '417 00', '119 00' in order; a separate crop of band 5 renders '346 29'; the control crop one pitch below band 5 renders EMPTY. p3: 1000 dpi crop spanning bands 1-4 renders '40', '417', '119', '346' in order; the control crop one pitch below band 4 renders empty but for the descender of the row-4 digits.
gates.balance_chain: 922 - 922 = 0; cover line 4 prints a hand-drawn 0 in the THIS column and a slashed 0 in the CUMULATIVE column. Closes exactly on the filer's own rounded figures. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing LAST-REPORT chain check was possible; the LAST REPORT column is blank on every line, consistent with this being the only report.

escalation_note: 1000 dpi amount-cell crops on p2 (bands 1-3, band 5, control) and p3 (bands 1-4, control); 700 dpi crops of the p2 and p3 name/date columns; 600 dpi crop of the cover anchor block.
notes: index.csv calls the candidate Barnard Jon White / office County Council; the cover reads 'Barnard Jon White', 'Name of Office: Cache County Council', 'Office District: South' - agrees, in scope. WORTH A HUMAN EYE: this filer used Form A as a MIRROR of Form B - the same four transactions appear on both schedules, with the candidate himself named as the contributor on three of them (self-funding) and the VENDOR 'Macies' named as the contributor on the fourth. The Form A entries are transcribed exactly as written; no inference is drawn about whether row 3 is really a contribution. NO ROW ON EITHER SCHEDULE CARRIES A YEAR: the dates are written 'Mar 7', 'April', 'April', 'Sept 22', so every date field on all eight rows is BLANK with needs_review=1 and the verbatim kept in the row note - the report's own date (Oct 22, 08) was NOT used to fill them. Cover street address, ZIP and home phone discarded at read time; the Form A row-1 address cell also carried a street address, likewise discarded (city 'Paradise' and 'Utah' kept), and the row-2 address cell holds a bare ZIP, which is discarded leaving the city blank.
